packages/app/src/gateway.ts.all-in-one: closes the package Actors an earlier release ran and starts the programs, from programs.ts
packages/app/src/gateway.ts.person: resolves @agentorg/shell's package.json to find the frontend build it carries

packages/computer/src/provider.ts.coordinator: runs @agentorg/mcp's Connection to answer tools@1 for each computer's MCP endpoint, and its parseConnection to check a remote computer's address

packages/sdk/src/cli.ts.coordinator: loads @agentorg/hub by name to run a Hub for `agentorg hub`

packages/app/test/api.test.ts.all-in-one: takes serveSocket from the package's index.ts, which re-exports it from api.ts

packages/app/test/gateway.test.ts.all-in-one: takes startApp and SignIn from the package's index.ts, which re-exports them from gateway.ts and signin.ts

packages/app/test/oauth.test.ts.all-in-one: takes oauthRoute from the package's index.ts, which re-exports it from oauth.ts

packages/assistant/test/provider.test.ts.coordinator: stands up a real Hub to test against

packages/assistant/test/run-path.test.ts.coordinator: stands up a real Hub to test against

packages/chatgpt/test/program.test.ts.coordinator: stands up a real Hub to test against

packages/chatgpt/test/session-version.te.coordinator: stands up a real Hub to test against

packages/computer/test/provider.test.ts.coordinator: stands up a real Hub to test against

packages/shell/scripts/build.js.all-in-one: reads the cli's package.json for its version, which it writes into dist/frontend.json as the release the frontend comes with

packages/shell/test/frontend.test.ts.all-in-one: reads the cli's package.json for its version, to check that dist/frontend.json names the same release
